title: docs(skills): service-registry examples call the contracts they annotate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRkstWwTJ4M4jpTEC7cnH7U)_

Refs #31112 (slice 6 of a per-skill split: item 4, objectstack-platform's plugin-lifecycle, service-registry and plugin-hooks files; the card stays open)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectstack-platform 技能包 `rules/service-registry.md` 里的示例改为真正符合服务契约的调用:数据引擎查询改用 `db.find('account')`,三处实时服务发布改为传入一个带 type/payload/timestamp 的事件对象,API 小节的方法数由“三个”更正为“四个”;三份文件的 40 段 TypeScript 示例仍无一段能接入示例编译检查。
- 为什么改:这些示例调用了契约里没有或签名不符的方法,AI 照抄后编译即报错;接不进检查的原因是这 40 段全部依赖 `@objectstack/core` 的运行时类型,而检查只能解析 `@objectstack/spec`。
- 风险与回滚:只改发布技能包里的五行文字,不动任何运行时代码,token 用量 1764 → 1808(上限 2331,未抬)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md` 第 113、126 行,以及第 222、232 行的 ❌/✅ 对照。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md`,预期只见这五行改动,且调用与 `packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts` 的 `find`、`realtime-service.ts` 的 `publish` 签名一致。
- 需要你做的:作为受管面审批人审阅并批准本 PR(skills/** 属 Tier H)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md`, example lines that make a call the service contract refuses, plus one count:

- L113, Basic Usage: the `objectql` service is read as `IDataEngine` (what `getService` returns by contract) and then called as `db.object('account').find()`. `IDataEngine` declares no `object` member (TS2339). Now `await db.find('account')`, the contract's own `find(objectName, query?, options?)`. The annotation stays.
- L126, Optional Services: `realtime` is read as `IRealtimeService` and called as `publish('my-event', data)`. The contract's `publish` takes one `RealtimeEventPayload` (TS2554, expected 1 argument, got 2). Now `await realtime.publish({ type: 'my-event', payload: data, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })`, which passes the payload's three required keys (`type`, `payload`, `timestamp`; `object` is optional) and awaits the `Promise<void>` the contract returns.
- L222 and L232, the "No Error Handling for Optional Service" ❌/✅ pair: both halves called `realtime.publish('event', data)` with two arguments. Both now pass the same one-payload shape as L126. Only the call's arity changes; the pair still teaches the try/catch.
- L7: "three core methods" → "four core methods", the number the block below it lists.

No marks are added. None of the 40 column-0 `ts`/`typescript` blocks in `rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` (9), `rules/service-registry.md` (15) and `references/plugin-hooks.md` (16) can carry the os:check marker, because every one needs `@objectstack/core` (the runtime `PluginContext`, `Plugin`, `ServiceLifecycle` or kernel), which `check:skill-examples` cannot resolve: it compiles against `@objectstack/spec` only.

| File | marked before → after / blocks | tokens before → after / ceiling | lines before → after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` | 0 → 0 / 9 | 1787 (untouched) / 2408 | 262 (untouched) |
| `rules/service-registry.md` | 0 → 0 / 15 | 1764 → 1808 / 2331 | 260 → 260 |
| `references/plugin-hooks.md` | 0 → 0 / 16 | 2413 (untouched) / 2628 | 290 (untouched) |

Skills bundle reading: no `SKILL.md` is touched, so the sum of every published `SKILL.md` does not move.

## Why

#31112 item 4 (ruling B of #22059) puts published examples under the opt-in type check, and the defect it exists to catch is an example teaching a call the contract refuses. These blocks cannot be marked, so the check cannot reach them; they were found by probing each block against `@objectstack/core`'s real declarations instead.

### Example fixes

- `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md:113`: `db.object('account').find()` on an `IDataEngine` (no such member) → `db.find('account')`.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md:126`: `realtime.publish('my-event', data)` (two arguments) → `await realtime.publish({ type, payload, timestamp })` (one `RealtimeEventPayload`).
- `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md:222` and `:232`: `realtime.publish('event', data)` (two arguments) → `await realtime.publish({ type: 'event', payload: data, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() })`.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md:7`: "three core methods" → "four core methods" (the block lists `registerService`, `getService`, `replaceService`, `getServices`).

## Tests

<details><summary>Spec-surface probe: 0 of 40 blocks can be marked</summary>

Each of the 40 blocks was written to its own file under the kept `.examples-build/tsconfig.json` (from `check:skill-examples --keep` on `main` b6fa08e3) and asked for syntactic, then semantic, diagnostics through the TypeScript API, so one block's syntax error cannot suppress another's semantic pass.

- 22 blocks do not parse at top level: bare `async init(ctx: PluginContext) {` / `start` / `destroy` method fragments (TS1434), and the service-registry API signature listing.
- The other 18 fail on names only `@objectstack/core` provides: `Cannot find module '@objectstack/core'` (TS2307), or `ctx`, `kernel`, `PluginContext`, `ServiceLifecycle` undefined (TS2304). In `plugin-lifecycle.md` the `const MyPlugin: Plugin` block and in `service-registry.md` the two `AnalyticsPlugin` blocks resolve `Plugin` to the DOM lib's `Plugin` (the checker header's trap 2).
- `@objectstack/core` is not resolvable from `packages/spec` (no workspace dependency), and the spec's own `kernel` `PluginContext` is an unrelated shape (`ql`, `os`, `logger`, `storage` …) with no `hook`, `trigger`, `registerService` or `getService`, so a wrapper would have to invent the type it claims to check.
</details>

<details><summary>Off-gate probe against @objectstack/core: the two fixes, red before and green after</summary>

Same harness, with `@objectstack/core` mapped to its built `dist/index.d.ts`, `IDataEngine` / `ICacheService` / `IRealtimeService` imported from `@objectstack/spec/contracts`, bare method fragments wrapped in a class, and `ctx`, `kernel` and `data` declared.

- Before (`main` b6fa08e3): Basic Usage → `L113 TS2339 Property 'object' does not exist on type 'IDataEngine'`; Optional Services → `L126 TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 2`.
- After (commit f5ca01e8): both blocks report 0 diagnostics, with no diagnostic code filtered.
- The L222/L232 pair reads `realtime` from an untyped `getService('realtime')`, so as written it is `unknown` (TS18046) and the probe cannot see the arity. The probe copy therefore reads it as `getService<IRealtimeService>('realtime')` (the document is unchanged there). Before (738209c2): `L222 TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 2` and `L232 TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 2`. After (08f5d7cb): both blocks report 0 diagnostics.
</details>

<details><summary>check:skill-examples</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` exits 0 on `main` b6fa08e3, on f5ca01e8 and on 08f5d7cb, each with `✅ 343 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`. The count does not move because no mark is added. No reverse check applies: there is no newly marked block to plant an error in.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate sweep (head f5ca01e8)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 44 commands. 43 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package's dist; CI runs it). `dispatch-gates --ran` exited 0: 44 derived, 43 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun.

Head 738209c2 = f5ca01e8 + a merge of `main` 3f0e3ace touching no `skills/` or `packages/spec/` path; re-run there, each exit 0: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `pnpm check:skill-links`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`. Head 08f5d7cb (REWORK after contract review 6736459920, F1 plus the L7 count) re-ran, each exit 0: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `pnpm check:skill-links`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`. PR-body gates on this body, each exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-partof-closing-keyword`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `check:skill-examples` is not in the derived gate list for a `skills/**` diff, so it was run by hand.
- Observation, not filed: the platform skill's plugin examples sit outside the checker's reach as long as it compiles prose only against `@objectstack/spec`. Bringing them in would take a surface that resolves `@objectstack/core`.
- Accepted as is per the contract review (F2): a rejected `publish` inside the L232 `try` is logged as "not available"; that is the file's existing shape. L17's `replaceService(name, instance: any)` is left as is.
- No ceiling was raised or lowered; the ratchet printed no lowering instruction.
- This build ran on the default tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates Fable for `skills/**`, and the claim records the no-Fable-build exit; the contract review is the seat's, on the lane's isolated reviewer.

## Verification

`git diff origin/main -- skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md` shows the five changed lines; `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (needs `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/client-react` built) prints 343 examples green.

## Human Minimum

A governed approver reviews and approves (Tier H).
